criteria.description: The summary header shows worker identity, full pubkey, separate liveness and scheduling badges, and state-aware cordon/drain/maintenance quick actions.
evidence: web/src/routes/workers/[pubkey]/+page.svelte renders summary-pubkey, liveness-* badge, scheduling-* badge, and QUICK_ACTIONS buttons backed by worker command request kinds 5997-6002.

criteria.description: The scheduling section explains scheduling state, note/reason, queue depth, max concurrency, accepting-new-work status, and drain blockers.
evidence: schedulingRows includes scheduling state, note/reason, current_queue_depth, max_concurrent_jobs, accepting new work, remaining assignments, and pinned drain blockers.

criteria.description: The capabilities section renders workload kinds, runtimes, toolchains, artifact formats, accelerators, features, and cached artifacts from current worker capability fields.
evidence: capabilityRows combines worker.capabilities and worker.ml_capabilities through guarded helper functions.

criteria.description: The resources section renders CPU, memory, disk, GPU/accelerator count, accelerator memory, architecture, and accelerator inventory.
evidence: resourceRows derives host resources and aggregate accelerator values, while acceleratorData renders the accelerator inventory table.

criteria.description: The labels and placement section displays labels, example selectors, copy selector actions, and an edit labels action that publishes a Nostr worker label update command.
evidence: workerLabelEntries renders label chips, selectorRows renders worker and label selectors, copySelector uses the Clipboard API, and LABEL_ACTION publishes kind 6003 through publishCommand.

criteria.description: The active assignments section renders current assignments when present and identifies movable, pinned, and drain-blocking assignments.
evidence: activeAssignments reads assignment-state fields, assignmentRows derives Movement and Drain columns, and drainBlockerData renders a warning panel for pinned or non-movable blockers.

criteria.description: The pricing section renders advertised pricing tiers using current domain.Worker pricing fields.
evidence: pricingData maps worker.pricing tiers to mint URL, price/sec, and hourly estimate rows.
